SELECT plan.PLAN_ID AS planId, plan.TITLE AS title, region.REGION_NAME AS regionName, member.MEMBER_NAME AS ownerName, plan.START_DATE AS startDate, plan.END_DATE AS endDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLAN_LIKE plan_like WHERE plan_like.PLAN_ID = plan.PLAN_ID) AS likeCount, plan.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, plan.VISIBILITY AS visibility, plan.PLAN_STATUS AS planStatus, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORT report WHERE report.PLAN_ID = plan.PLAN_ID) AS reportCount, (SELECT MAX(report.REPORT_ID) FROM REPORT report WHERE report.PLAN_ID = plan.PLAN_ID) AS latestReportId, (SELECT report.REPORT_STATUS FROM REPORT report WHERE report.REPORT_ID = ( SELECT MAX(latest_report.REPORT_ID) FROM REPORT latest_report WHERE latest_report.PLAN_ID = plan.PLAN_ID )) AS latestReportStatus FROM TRAVEL_PLAN plan JOIN MEMBER member ON member.MEMBER_ID = plan.OWNER_MEMBER_ID JOIN REGION_MASTER region ON region.REGION_CODE = plan.REGION_CODE WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( plan.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR member.MEMBER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND plan.VISIBILITY = #{visibility}
AND plan.REGION_CODE = #{regionCode}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REPORT report_filter WHERE report_filter.PLAN_ID = plan.PLAN_ID )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REPORT report_status WHERE report_status.PLAN_ID = plan.PLAN_ID AND report_status.REPORT_ID = ( SELECT MAX(latest_status.REPORT_ID) FROM REPORT latest_status WHERE latest_status.PLAN_ID = plan.PLAN_ID ) AND report_status.REPORT_STATUS IN ('RESOLVED', 'COMPLETED') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REPORT report_status WHERE report_status.PLAN_ID = plan.PLAN_ID AND report_status.REPORT_ID = ( SELECT MAX(latest_status.REPORT_ID) FROM REPORT latest_status WHERE latest_status.PLAN_ID = plan.PLAN_ID ) AND report_status.REPORT_STATUS NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'COMPLETED') )
ORDER BY plan.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT plan.PLAN_ID AS planId, plan.TITLE AS title, region.REGION_NAME AS regionName, plan.OWNER_MEMBER_ID AS ownerMemberId, member.MEMBER_NAME AS ownerName, plan.START_DATE AS startDate, plan.END_DATE AS endDate, plan.VISIBILITY AS visibility, plan.PLAN_STATUS AS planStatus, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLAN_MEMBER participant WHERE participant.PLAN_ID = plan.PLAN_ID) AS participantCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLAN_LIKE plan_like WHERE plan_like.PLAN_ID = plan.PLAN_ID) AS likeCount, plan.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRAVEL_PLAN copied_plan WHERE copied_plan.SOURCE_PLAN_ID = plan.PLAN_ID) AS copyCount FROM TRAVEL_PLAN plan JOIN MEMBER member ON member.MEMBER_ID = plan.OWNER_MEMBER_ID JOIN REGION_MASTER region ON region.REGION_CODE = plan.REGION_CODE WHERE plan.PLAN_ID = #{planId}

SELECT item.SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID AS scheduleItemId, plan_day.DAY_NO AS dayNo, plan_day.TRAVEL_DATE AS travelDate, item.TIME_SLOT AS timeSlot, item.POSITION_NO AS positionNo, item.PLACE_NAME_SNAPSHOT AS placeName, item.CATEGORY_SNAPSHOT AS category, item.ADDRESS_SNAPSHOT AS address, item.LATITUDE_SNAPSHOT AS latitude, item.LONGITUDE_SNAPSHOT AS longitude FROM PLAN_DAY plan_day JOIN PLAN_SCHEDULE_ITEM item ON item.PLAN_DAY_ID = plan_day.PLAN_DAY_ID WHERE plan_day.PLAN_ID = #{planId} ORDER BY plan_day.DAY_NO, item.TIME_SLOT, item.POSITION_NO

SELECT report.REPORT_ID AS reportId, report.REPORTER_MEMBER_ID AS reporterMemberId, member.MEMBER_NAME AS reporterName, report.REASON_CODE AS reasonCode, report.REASON_DETAIL AS reasonDetail, report.REPORT_STATUS AS reportStatus, report.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM REPORT report JOIN MEMBER member ON member.MEMBER_ID = report.REPORTER_MEMBER_ID WHERE report.PLAN_ID = #{planId} ORDER BY report.CREATED_AT DESC
